- Do not use local `main` or the Rork-router remote as proof of canonical GitHub `main`.
- Do not ask the user to repeat secure-token submission while the Rork secure-variable handoff remains broken.
- Do not request credentials in chat.
- Investigate the reported live issue as an incident first; do not assume it is only a harmless Render log warning without extracting the relevant log content and source code.
- Keep any repair bounded to an `auto-fix/<incident-id>` branch with failing regression coverage, PR, required CI, owner approval, merge, and verified deployment.
